summary: Master risk management in oil and gas projects with our expert-led training course. Equip yourself with essential tools to navigate industry challenges.
lede: Risk management for oil and gas projects helps project managers, engineers, and HSE and process safety professionals identify and assess project risks. The course covers building risk registers, using qualitative and basic quantitative assessment tools, and incorporating safety findings into project decisions. Participants also explore planning risk responses and communicating priorities to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly face uncertainty, risk trade-offs, and safety obligations in oil and gas projects.
audience: Project managers and project engineers in upstream
Asset integrity, maintenance, and reliability engineers
Risk managers and internal auditors focused
EPC contractor and service company leaders
modules: Foundations of Risk Management in Oil and Gas Projects
Project Context and Stakeholder Risk Expectations
HSE and Process Safety Risk Assessment
Qualitative and Quantitative Risk Assessment Tools
Financial, Commercial, and Contract Risks in Oil and Gas Projects
Governance, Compliance, and ESG in Risk Management
Monitoring, Reporting, and Learning From Incidents and Near Misses
Communicating and Leading on Risk in Oil and Gas Projects
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of oil and gas operations and project management principles. Experience in a related role is beneficial but not required.
